meaning:
Gazer or Gezer = "portion"
a Levitical city on the border of Ephraim
Also named: gov (גֹּב "Gob" H1359)

elsewhere.note: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua struck him and his people, until he had left him no one remaining.
Ephraim didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, but the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them.
David did so, as Yahweh commanded him, and struck the Philistines all the way from Geba to Gezer.
This is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised, to build Yahweh’s house, his own house, Millo, Jerusalem’s wall, Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.
They gave to them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its pasture lands, and Gezer with its pasture lands,
